body.goal: fix the failed v2 H2 (adaptive improver > frozen improver) with a shared continuous contextual meta-predictor trained on every candidate x probe paired outcome, a TRAIN -> META-VALIDATION -> FINAL HOLDOUT family split, and structurally distinct, diagnosis-conditioned improvement actions
body.note: append-only; every v3 dev iteration, dev-check, freeze, confirm START/END and report is recorded here, including failed and null runs

body.rule: design iteration on dev_iterate only; dev_check used only for go/no-go before freezing (every look recorded); confirm seeds never run before PREREG_FREEZE

body.label: diagnosis-after-dev05
body.note: Measured on dev seeds 3001-3004 (world 1): split-half reliability of a candidate's paired meta-val gain is r=0.47 with 48 probes/half at 600 executions/probe (0.34 at 300, 0.61 at 1500), i.e. ~0.1 on the 6 probes a round screens; per-probe noise SD ~0.23 vs true candidate-gain SD ~0.03. dev-02 ORACLE_RANK (sees true screen outcomes, not compute-matched) +1.0 vs FROZEN single-world, but -0.25 in 4-world dev-03: screen-probe gains do not transfer, the screen signal is mostly noise. dev-04 empirical-Bayes gate REJECTED: it weakened the control (FROZEN 19.67 vs 23.42 with the old gate, p=0.007) -- ADAPTIVE's apparent +1.75 was compensation for a hobbled control. dev-05 predictor-dominated finalist choice REJECTED: -2.5 vs FROZEN. Prototype deterministic best-first enumeration solver (not ledgered as a run; scratch): split-half r 0.22 progress / 0.29 solved vs EA 0.21/0.07 in the same harness, lower solve rates (COLD 0.097 vs 0.139, oracle 0.47 vs 0.60) -> noise is task heterogeneity, not search luck; prototype discarded. Decision: return to dev-03 design; tune ARM-AGNOSTIC knobs (gate, k) on FROZEN_META only; tune predictor knobs on meta_quality only.

body.label: diagnosis-after-dev08
body.note: Arm-agnostic gate sweep on FROZEN_META only (dev 3001-3012): strict 23.42, noninferior 25.17, always 26.25 (adopt best screened) -> 'always' is the strongest control and is used from dev-07 on. dev-07 (always gate): ADAPTIVE-FROZEN +0.17 (null). dev-08 pooled analysis of 3,837 randomly screened candidates (FROZEN, 24 seeds): candidate-level y variance 0.0095 of which ~0.0092 is probe noise; out-of-seed ridge R2 = 0.017 (main effects) ~ 60% of the non-noise variance -> proposal value IS learnable, but the learning curve needs ~800 candidates to reach R2>0 and ~2,800 for R2~0.012, while a 4-world run sees ~800 in total -> within-run meta-learning was data-starved. Full action x diagnosis block overfits (R2 0.007-0.014) vs main+matched (0.016). Decision: compact predictor (main effects + action x matched failure score) and longer improvement streams (more worlds per run, equal per-world budgets for every arm).

body.label: alignment-diagnostic
body.note: Dev seeds 3033-3038 (world 1, after 2 attempt rounds), 86 pool candidates: correlation between a candidate's paired META-VAL gain (60 probes) and its FINAL-holdout gain (40 tasks) = -0.045; split-half reliabilities 0.316 (meta-val) and 0.484 (final) would allow ~0.56. Mean gains are positive on both (+0.52 progress on 60 meta-val probes, +0.91 of 40 final tasks), but WHICH candidate helps most does not transfer between disjoint family sets. Implication: a meta-predictor trained on meta-val outcomes can improve the final metric only through coarse, family-independent regularities (e.g. avoiding EXPLORE). dev-10 (24 seeds, 10 worlds, always gate): ADAPTIVE-FROZEN ext +1.67 (p=0.20), in +2.33 (p=0.02), meta_quality +0.0064 (p=0.003); ADAPTIVE-NOCARRY ext +2.04 (p=0.10), meta_quality +0.0058 (p=0.005); ADAPTIVE-NODIAG ~0; adopted-candidate screen score ~0.10 in every arm (best-of-k selection on noise); ADAPTIVE adopts EXPLORE 12% vs FROZEN 19%.

GO_requires_all: ADAPTIVE_META - FROZEN_META on ext (final holdout, summed over worlds): mean > 0 and one-sided paired permutation p < 0.05
ADAPTIVE_META - ADAPTIVE_NOCARRY on ext: mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.10
ADAPTIVE_META - FROZEN_META on meta_quality: mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05
per-world advantage in the second half of the worlds >= the first half (persists or grows)

body.label: diagnosis-after-devcheck01
body.note: Go/no-go on 3101-3200 (n=100, dev-10 configuration): NO_GO by the preregistered rule. Passed: ADAPTIVE-FROZEN ext +1.35 [0.09, 2.68] one-sided p=0.022; meta_quality +0.0044 p<1e-4; persistence (per-world ADAPTIVE-FROZEN second half +0.21 >= first half +0.06). FAILED: ADAPTIVE-NOCARRY ext +0.53 [-0.82, 1.89] p=0.23 (threshold 0.10), so the cross-world carry-over is not shown to improve the final metric. Read-only analysis (results/v3_devcheck_report.json): ADAPTIVE-NOCARRY per world is -0.09 in worlds 1-5 and +0.20 in worlds 6-10 (per-seed trend +1.47, two-sided p=0.02); meta_quality ADAPTIVE-NOCARRY +0.0036 p=0.0008; rank validity (within-round Spearman predicted vs realized cross-family META-VAL gain) +0.066 p<1e-4, rising from 0.03 (world 1) to 0.10 (world 10); NODIAG-ADAPTIVE ext +0.34 (diagnosis adds nothing to the final metric); every arm >> SINGLE_COMPUTE_MATCHED (+12 to +14). Interpretation: the meta-learned ranking is real and keeps improving with cross-world data, but over 10 worlds most of its final-metric benefit is already captured by within-world learning (NOCARRY-FROZEN ~ +0.8); the carry-over component is small and back-loaded.

body.design: memory -> PROCESS CONTROL (rsi_v3.controller). Episodic improvement memory (per tested candidate and per round: state -> intervention -> resource allocation -> immediate / delayed same-world / cross-world transfer gain -> compute) and generalised meta-memory (Bayesian ridge value model over edit variants x context; one Bayesian ridge per round-level process option; adaptive episodic/generalised retrieval weight). The plan controls proposal generation over a parameterised variant grid (bundle size, prior step, flattening, search depth, composition depth, pruning), pool allocation across strategies, attempt compute allocation (base/focus/deep), screening shape (12x4 / 8x6 / 6x8), exploration (ranking slots + Thompson scale), adoption rule, retrieval. A per-world tracking set of 16 fresh META-VAL probes (never used for selection) gives the delayed and transfer horizons. Records hold numbers and labels only (no solver content).
body.identity: with the default plan the FROZEN process arm reproduces v3 FROZEN_META's decisions exactly (checked on seeds 3001-3004, tiny budgets); MEMORY_CARRY == NO_CARRY throughout world 1
body.label: process-controller
body.motivation: observational analysis of the spent go/no-go battery (FROZEN_META, 1000 worlds): at the level of edit VARIANTS the META-VAL signal agrees with the final holdout (corr 0.63 over 26 variants) although it does not at the level of individual candidates (-0.045); variant-level differences need hundreds of observations -> learnable only across worlds

body.label: pc-01-frozen-sweep-decision
body.note: Arm-agnostic sweep of every new round-level process option as a FIXED setting on FROZEN only (seeds 3001-3024, n=24, 10 worlds): vs the v3 default process, attempt-focus -1.00 [-3.58, +1.54], attempt-deep +1.29 [-2.04, +4.42] (p2=0.47), shape-broad +0.04, shape-deep -0.71 (final-holdout ext). No fixed alternative is reliably better, so the default plan stays the v3 process (the strongest known control, chosen on FROZEN in dev-06). The default FROZEN process arm reproduces the v3 FROZEN_META units bit-for-bit at full budgets (identical final configs and ext on all 16 overlapping dev-10 seeds).

body.label: diagnosis-after-pc-02
body.note: pc-02 (dev 3001-3024, n=24, 10 worlds): ext MEMORY_CARRY 63.17, MEMORY_RANKONLY 62.83, NO_CARRY 62.42, FROZEN 60.17; MEMORY_CARRY-NO_CARRY ext +0.75 (p1=0.35), no growth over worlds; in-family MEMORY_CARRY-FROZEN +4.17 (p1=0.003). Meta level: world-end cross-family transfer on the tracking probes MEMORY_CARRY-NO_CARRY +0.0096/probe (p2=0.003), MEMORY_CARRY-MEMORY_RANKONLY +0.0085 (p2=0.022); MEMORY_CARRY's adopted grid-extra variants have tracking effect +0.0138 vs NO_CARRY's +0.0068 (memory learns WHICH extras help). Defects: round-level knob models are data-starved (return-to-go sd 0.051 vs option differences ~0.005 -> ~400 rows needed, 50 available) so Thompson draws were near-random (60% non-default from world 3); macro count 7.3/world vs FROZEN 3.7; per-world corr(tracking transfer, ext) only 0.08.

body.note: pc-03 (fresh dev 3041-3088, n=48, knob margin): ext MEMORY_CARRY 64.96, NO_CARRY 62.77, MEMORY_RANKONLY 60.83, FROZEN 58.10. body.label: control-strength-after-pc-04
body.note: pc-04a (arm-agnostic check, FROZEN only, dev 3041-3088, n=48): a FIXED uninformed prior over the whole variant grid beats the v3 variant list: FROZEN_GRID - FROZEN ext +3.21 [+1.08, +5.42] p2=0.007, in +2.92. So the v3-list FROZEN was not the strongest fixed control and NO_CARRY-FROZEN in pc-03 (+4.67) overstated learning: NO_CARRY - FROZEN_GRID is only +1.46 (p2=0.14) while MEMORY_CARRY - FROZEN_GRID is +3.65 [+1.17, +6.10] p2=0.006. pc-04b ablation: MEMORY_GENONLY (memory -> generation/ranking, round-level options at default) ext 64.60 vs MEMORY_CARRY 64.96 (+0.35, n.s.) and vs NO_CARRY +1.83 (p2=0.105): the carry effect lives in memory -> generation; the round-level options add nothing detectable.

body.label: diagnosis-after-pc-05
body.note: pc-05 (dev 3041-3088, n=48, whole-grid prior for every arm): ext MEMORY_CARRY 63.46, NO_CARRY 61.94, MEMORY_RANKONLY 61.90, MEMORY_GENONLY 61.83, FROZEN 61.31. MEMORY_CARRY-NO_CARRY +1.52 [-1.02, +4.17] p1=0.13 (in +1.92, p1=0.035); MEMORY_CARRY-FROZEN +2.15 p1=0.051; NO_CARRY-FROZEN +0.63 n.s. Mean paired gain of screened candidates rises with experience for MEMORY_CARRY (world 1 0.0053, worlds 2-5 0.0062, worlds 6-10 0.0102) vs NO_CARRY 0.0066 and FROZEN 0.0040 in worlds 6-10, but the adopted edits' unbiased tracking effect differs only ~15% (selection among 8 candidates on 6 noisy probes dilutes it). The carried memory predicts screen outcomes (corr(mu, y) 0.354 vs 0.120 for NO_CARRY) but not the adopted edits' tracking effect (~0), so memory-driven adoption would not help. Dev history MEMORY_CARRY-NO_CARRY ext: +0.75 (pc-02), +2.19 (pc-03), +1.52 (pc-05).
